title: Production Recovery governed baseline-only authority bridge

phases.objective: Close the missing server-managed Production Recovery baseline-rebuild wiring while retaining explicit external activation and fail-closed ordinary migration/grant authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Production Recovery Kernel and Hostinger host-local baseline executor
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One approved baseline.rebuild_empty role step is converted into an exact host-local bootstrap invocation, rebound to the exact checkout bundle, and independently read back without widening authority.
steps: Derive a step-scoped role-selection proof from the immutable durable multi-role Recovery plan.
Bind one server-issued execution ticket to one role, one role-selection hash, and one exact role-bundle binding.
Translate only the approved baseline role step into controlled host-local Runtime Bootstrap environment inputs.
Recompute and compare the exact checkout role bundle before the first DDL boundary.
Require the role to become non-empty with required role tables present in independent same-cycle readback.
assertions: Exactly one role is executable per Recovery step and ticket.
Caller-selected repository, workflow, ref, host, path, credential, token, raw SQL, and shell routing remain forbidden.
Role-bundle mismatch fails before database mutation.
Ordinary migration apply and grant repair are not included.
Partial or unknown execution remains reconciliation-only with automatic rerun forbidden.
No Production operation is performed by synthetic certification.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The canonical Production factory can certify a baseline-only live authority graph only under explicit Hostinger Production runtime intent and server-owned authority material, while source merge remains non-activating.
steps: Require explicit Hostinger Production runtime identity and production_live binding intent.
Build ticket and approval authorities over the independent mutation-grade Recovery Control Store.
Compose durable proof, immutable partial receipt, baseline-only mutation, and independent readback authorities.
Expose a complete server-managed Recovery envelope with a baseline_rebuild_only live authorization scope.
Keep the ordinary Governance Migration Ledger finalizer fail-closed.
assertions: Missing server-owned approval or signing material fails closed.
Disabled binding intent cannot activate Production live authority.
The composition performs no provider or database activity while it is being resolved.
The envelope contains no secret values.

phases.objective: Keep actual Production activation and baseline execution blocked until exact deployed-source, live store, configuration, fresh inspection, and separate typed execution authority are proven.
